title: command: a command queued for the coming day, or refused with the engine's reason
description: The answer of set_intent, withdraw_intent, set_limit, set_leave, set_pursuit, answer_pursuit, hold, release, approve, cancel_plan, set_interrupt and acknowledge, and of a preview or an approve of a preview that was refused. The command is checked at once by taking it in after the commands already queued; a refused command is not queued. A command queued can still be refused when the day begins if the state has changed.

inside_day.description: Given only at 0600 or 1200, in a game that stops between pulses (decision 0156): the answer was worked on the state as it stands, as if the open day were closed now, before the rest of the day, its fight ashore and its end are resolved; a command is checked again when it is taken in at the next dusk.

reason.description: For a refused command: the engine's reason in words, in your numbers.

intent.description: For a set_intent with no number given: the number chosen.

preview.description: For an approve of a preview: the preview's number. The command is the one the preview showed.

limits_queued.description: For an approve of a preview of an order with limits given with it: the number of limit commands queued with the order (decision 0222, rule 4). `queued` counts all.

of_batch.description: For a refusal of one of the commands of an order and its limits given as one: which of them it is, 1 for the order and 2 up for its limits in the order given, and how many there are. Nothing of the batch is queued.

interrupt.description: For a set_interrupt with no number given: the number chosen.
